Name: Just Another Bachelors' Portraits Mod
Author: jionestellos
Description:
[center][size=4]Just Another Bachelors' Portraits Mod[/size]

[size=2]Just a mod that replaces the portraits of SDV's bachelors with artwork in my own style.
Please enjoy!


[b]Update[/b] (14/7/2019): I've compiled the mod into a Content Patcher compatible version.
Due to constraints and reasons in real life, I am, and have not been, able to expand on other characters' portraits, at least for the forseeable future. :<

 
[b]How to install (CP version):[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Download the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[/size]
[*][size=2]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/size]
[*]Download and extract files
[*]Copy and Paste the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]

[b]How to install:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract .xnb file.
[*]Find where your game files are installed \Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits
[*](I recommend backing up your old files) Just replace and overwrite "[character].xnb".
[/list]

[b]Credits:
[/b]Stardew Valley belongs to [url=http://stardewvalley.net/]ConcernedApe[/url] 
[/size]Redone portrait artwork by JionEstellos (a.k.a. ShiroMisaki)[/center]
